Labcorp/NASHnext economics, flagged by the company for 'l'automne'. They may land here or at the autumn investor day. Probably positive if disclosed, timing unknown
H1 revenue about EUR 21m (royalties), which can be worked out from Ipsen's figures. Net loss and opex are new but not what moves the stock. No change expected against what the market can compute
